title: PaceProof Attestation Record
description: Canonical schema for a single Ed25519-signed compute-attestation record. This is the single source of truth: both the TypeScript package (packages/cli-ts) and the Python package (packages/cli-py) validate against a copy of this exact file. PaceProof does not generate or sign these records -- it only ingests, verifies, and reports on records that already conform to this schema.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this attestation record, assigned by the issuing provider.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the record was issued.

provider.description: Free-text identifier for the issuing provider, e.g. "computeledger" or "acme-cloud".

compute_amount.description: Amount of compute in compute_unit's units.

compute_unit.description: Unit-agnostic by design, e.g. "gpu_hours" or "teraflop_seconds", so any provider's native unit works.

issuer_public_key.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 public key of the issuer.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON encoding of every other field (record_id, issued_at, provider, hardware, workload_type, compute_amount, compute_unit, issuer_public_key), with object keys sorted lexicographically and no insignificant whitespace.
